title.ur: floor standing 4 ton air conditioner par E5 kharabi

meaning.en: E5 occurs on Haier floor-standing (4-ton) units. Official split meaning is anti-frost protection.
meaning.ur: Haier floor standing (4 ton) units par E5 aata hai; official split matlab anti-frost protection hai

causes.en: Same family as split E5: coil running too cold / protection trip (likely)
causes.ur: split E5 ke khaandan se mumkin: coil bohat thanda / hifazat trip

causes.en: Cause not explicitly stated in video text
causes.ur: video text mein wajah aaz taur par nahi likhi gayi

solutions.en: Power off; check airflow and refrigerant per split E5 guidance
solutions.ur: band karein; split E5 ke mutabiq hawa aur refrigerant check karein
E5 wapas aaye to service bulayein

source.title: Haier Floor Standing AC Error E5

title.en: E6 fault on 3-phase cabinet / floor-standing AC
title.ur: 3-phase cabinet / floor standing air conditioner par E6 kharabi

meaning.en: E6 on large Haier units is a communication and/or voltage failure between indoor and outdoor (errors.codes; video confirms occurrence on 3-phase cabinet).
meaning.ur: Bari Haier units par E6 indoor aur outdoor ke darmiyan communication aur/ya voltage ki naqami hai (errors.codes; video 3-phase cabinet par is hone ki tasdeeq karta hai).

causes.ur: units ke darmiyan wiring kharab ya munqata

causes.en: PCB electronic board problem (indoor or outdoor)
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor PCB electronic board ka masla

solutions.en: Visually check cables for looseness, damage, or sulfation and repair
solutions.ur: wiring ko nazar kar dhile, kharab ya zang wale hisson ki marammat karein

solutions.en: Technician inspects indoor/outdoor PCB if wiring is sound
solutions.ur: Wiring theek ho to technician indoor/outdoor PCB check kare

source.title: E6 Error Haier 4 Tan Cabinet / Floor Standing

notes.en: Meaning from errors.codes (https://errors.codes/en/haier/air-conditioning/error-e6); video confirms E6 exists on PK large units. E6 not on official split table. confidence low (video+SEO aggregator).
notes.ur: Matlab errors.codes (https://errors.codes/en/haier/air-conditioning/error-e6) se liya gaya hai; video se confirm hota hai ke PK ke bare units par E6 aata hai. E6 official split table par nahi. confidence low (video+SEO aggregator).

title.ur: floor standing air conditioner par E9 kharabi

meaning.en: E9 occurs on Haier floor-standing units (video). Official split meaning: indoor overload in heating mode.
meaning.ur: Haier floor-standing units par E9 aata hai (video). Official split matlab: heating mode mein indoor overload.

causes.ur: over load/zyada shiddat wali kaam ki hifazat (Official split se mumsal)

causes.en: Cause not restated in video text
causes.ur: video text mein wajah dobara nahi likhi gayi

solutions.en: Clean filters/coils and restart after cool-down (split E9 path)
solutions.ur: Filter/coil saaf karke thanda hone par phir restart karein (split E9 ka tareeqa)
Aur load wapas aaye to service bulayein

meaning.ur: F1 Haier 2–4 ton floor standing, cassette aur cabinet units par aata hai. Official matlab: IPM protection
